text:
maria: running onboarding smoke for velvet-70k-int3 on quant3 hybrid — noticed weird prefix divergence when continuing long prompts (>40k).
eli: can you paste the minimal repro?
maria: repro is small: 
```
# repro script
python tests/repro_longctx.py --model velvet-70k-int3 --quant hybrid --context 65536 --seed 42
```
maria: observed: first 10k tokens match FP32 baseline, then outputs deviate, and kv-cache hit rate drops to near 0.
cheng: did you try disabling KV prefetch?
maria: yes — prefetch off still diverges, but cache indices look shifted in logs. snippet: 
```
KV_INDEX_SHARD 3 idx=1048575 -> 1048576
KV_INDEX_SHARD 3 idx=0 -> 1
```
maria: that wrap looks suspicious.
sam: are you reproducing across devices/shards or single-GPU?
maria: single A100 dev for this run. but we see the same effect in multi-shard cloud run.
eli: could be RoPE scaling interpolation after quant kernels change. any difference in rotary scale or pos emb preproc between quant and fp?
maria: verified embedding preprocess identical. suspect integer truncation in index math after int3 packing step.
natalie: I can try stepping through the kvcache indexing in debug build — can you point to the exact commit/cont that failed?
maria: head is 1f4b8a2 (onboard/velvet-int3). failing test: tests/longctx/velvet_kv_wrap_test.py
cheng: quick check — do logs show any memcopy sizes off-by-one? earlier we had similar symptoms with int4 where tile width mismatch produced off-by-one wrap.
maria: grep shows memcpy length sometimes equals 0 when idx wraps.
natalie: ok I'll run with ASAN debug and smaller context to step faster.
eli: small thought — when you pack int3, the per-token buffer alignment may change; if padding not handled, the ring buffer index arithmetic can overflow at the 2^20 boundary.
sam: cc @ci-bot can you kick a reproducible nightly job with both fp32 and int3 for velvet at 32k/48k/65k contexts and upload kvcache dumps?
ci-bot: scheduled job: rhyme/nightly/velvet-quant-compare at 2026-03-24T02:15Z. artifacts: s3://rhyme-artifacts/velvet/1833337777/ (kv-dumps, logits, traces).
maria: thanks — initial manual diff between fp32/int3 traces shows rotor-phase multiplier mismatch around token 10240 mark.
cheng: do you have diff snippet?
maria: yes: 
```
FP   attn_scale[10] = 0.998123
INT3 attn_scale[10] = 0.993210
```
maria: small scale drift cascades and makes cache hits miss due to key mismatch.
natalie: hypothesis: quant kernel uses slightly different floating-point path for rotary application (fast approx) — causes sub-token scale change.
eli: mitigation idea: add a conservative normalization step when loading keys from kvcache for int3 models (apply scale fudge) so small diffs won't break equality check. cheap and safe for rollout.
sam: can we A/B it? add normalization flag behind rollout and run 48h smoke.
maria: I'll prototype a patch: loader: if model.quant in ("int3","quant3") do key_norm = key / max(1e-6, l2norm(key)) * cached_norm_factor.
cheng: please also add unit that fuzzes small scale deltas and asserts stable hit rates.
maria: will do. pushing initial PR to branch velvet/kv-fix-1833337777 in 10m.
eli: nice. if that fails, next step is to rerun kernel generator with stricter FP fallback for rotary on long contexts.
maria: ping me if you want to pair on the ASAN run, natalie.
natalie: will join in 20.
ci-bot: PR opened: github.com/redwood-inference/serving/pull/5812 by maria — run tests queued.
sam: update here once we have nightly artifacts. :thumbsup:
eli: also add a short eval on the goldset (long-context QA) to ensure generation quality doesn't degrade.
maria: will add a small eval job in the PR pipeline.
